name: pounce-studio
description: Solve, diagnose, verify and live-debug nonlinear optimization models with the POUNCE solver.
long_description: POUNCE is a pure-Rust interior-point optimizer (a port of Ipopt 3.14 with convex QP/conic, active-set, sensitivity and MPCC engines). This extension lets Claude solve AMPL .nl models, explain why a solve failed, check a .sol file against the canonical model, preflight a starting point, and step through a live solve in POUNCE's debugger. Relative model paths are resolved against the Workspace folder you choose.

tools.name: analyze_problem
tools.description: Inspect a problem without solving it.

tools.name: run_problem
tools.description: Run a pounce solve and return the resulting report.

tools.name: verify_solution
tools.description: Independently verify that a .sol satisfies a .nl's constraints.

tools.name: check_x0
tools.description: Preflight a model's starting point before any solve.

tools.name: diagnose_model
tools.description: Check a model without solving it: contradictions, domain risks, dependent equations, scaling.

tools.name: suggest_initialization
tools.description: Preflight a model's starting point and propose concrete fixes.

tools.name: explain

tools.name: citations
